Active zones by default; geometries simplified for `zoom` and rounded to 6 decimals; at most ZONES_GEOJSON_MAX_FEATURES features and ZONES_GEOJSON_MAX_VERTICES vertices per response (`truncated`, `truncatedBy`). The response is streamed.

post.description:
Enqueues one geo.zone.upserted.v1 per zone in the outbox; the relay publishes them asynchronously.

Requires a platform administrator (super_admin); other users and API keys get 403 PLATFORM_ADMIN_REQUIRED.
post.summary: Republish the snapshot of every zone to the GEO stream (super_admin)

post.description: Dry run of the input rules of POST /zones (README steps 2-8), for editors while drawing: GeoJSON structure and WGS84 bounds, geometry type per kind, at most 50 000 vertices, bufferM > 0 for point zones, no edge across the antimeridian, properties of the kind, PostGIS ST_IsValidDetail. Nothing is stored or published. A broken rule answers 200 with valid=false and problem = the problem details POST /zones would answer (e.g. ZONE_GEOMETRY_INVALID with reason and location [lon, lat] of a self-intersection). Owner, quota, code, If-Match and snapshot size are checked by the write only. A malformed body (kind or geometry missing, bufferM out of range) answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

vertexCount.description: Number of positions, ring closures included

bbox.description: [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] of the geometry

total.description: Number of items across all pages

coordinates.description: Positions [longitude, latitude] (WGS84 degrees) nested as the geometry type requires; absent for GeometryCollection. A third coordinate (altitude) is dropped: zones are 2-D.

geometries.description: Members of a GeometryCollection (no nested collections)

zoneProperties.description: Kind-specific properties with the provenance (source), e.g. the pipeline KP markers

truncated.description: true when more zones matched than the budgets allow (zoom out with `zoom`, narrow the bbox or the kinds)

truncatedBy.description: The budget that cut the response; null when complete

limit.description: Largest number of features of one response (ZONES_GEOJSON_MAX_FEATURES)

vertexLimit.description: Largest number of vertices of one response, after simplification (ZONES_GEOJSON_MAX_VERTICES)

zoom.description: The requested zoom level; null = full resolution

enqueued.description: Zone snapshots enqueued in the outbox

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry in WGS84 degrees: the geometry type must fit the kind (pipeline: lines; transhipment_area, fishing_ground, mpa, shallow_water: polygons; restricted, anchorage, port: polygons or points with bufferM > 0; tss_lane: polygons or lines; custom: any), at most 50000 vertices, valid per PostGIS ST_IsValid (never repaired automatically)

properties.description: Kind-specific properties (contracts ZONE_PROPERTY_SCHEMAS), e.g. pipeline markers [{ name, lat, lon }], shallow_water depthM, port unlocode; unknown keys are kept; at most 64 KiB; "source" is reserved

valid.description: true when the draft passes every input rule checked here (README steps 2-8); it may still be refused by the write for its owner, quota, code, If-Match or snapshot size

problem.description: The problem details POST /zones would answer for this draft: the first rule it breaks, cheapest first. 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with errors on geometry.* (structure, WGS84 bounds) or properties.*; 422 ZONE_GEOMETRY_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED, ZONE_GEOMETRY_TOO_COMPLEX, ZONE_BUFFER_REQUIRED, ZONE_GEOMETRY_CROSSES_ANTIMERIDIAN (from, to, path) or ZONE_GEOMETRY_INVALID (reason and location [lon, lat] of PostGIS ST_IsValidDetail, e.g. a self-intersection). null when valid

geometryType.description: Type of the parsed geometry; null when its GeoJSON structure is invalid

vertexCount.description: Positions of the parsed geometry, ring closures included (the count the 50 000-vertex limit applies to); null when its structure is invalid

bbox.description: [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] of the parsed geometry; null when its structure is invalid
